ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed PingCastle Binary Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "PingCastle" binary based on the PE metadata fields.

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "PingCastleReporting\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "PingCastleCloud\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "PingCastle\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ aclcheck.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ antivirus.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ computerversion.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ foreignusers.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ laps\\_bitlocker.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ localadmin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ nullsession.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ nullsession\\-trust.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ oxidbindings.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ remote.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ share.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ smb.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ smb3querynetwork.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ spooler.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ startup.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-scanner\\ zerologon.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-no\\-enum\\-limit.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-healthcheck.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-level\\ Full.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-healthcheck.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-server\\ .*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\PingCastleReporting\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\PingCastleCloud\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\PingCastle\\\.exe$")))
